title: Repaint Only the Car
tests: Tests targeted car recolouring while preserving the original vehicle, lighting and surrounding scene.

faults.what: Some non-paint details were subtly regenerated, including the far-side rear light and bumper outline, background house details, and road cracks near the lower-right corner.

judge.summary: The car is convincingly navy blue with natural sunny reflections, but a few details outside the paint were subtly changed.

must_haves.item: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
must_haves.why: The body panels and roof are now a clearly dark navy blue.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
must_haves.why: The overall car is closely preserved, but the far-side rear light and rear bumper contour show small changes.

must_haves.item: Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
must_haves.why: The blue paint retains bright highlights, reflected houses, and shaded lower panels consistent with the sunny scene.

must_haves.item: The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: Small changes are visible in background architectural details and the lower-right road cracks.

must_haves.item: The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.
must_haves.why: The output preserves the supplied image's framing and aspect ratio without visible cropping.
